title: The Ascetic's Detonator
logline: A palliative hospice chaplain preparing an ascetic hermit for his final rites discovers that the revered holy man was a wartime passenger ferry saboteur hiding behind monastic sanctuary.

roles.description: Spiritual director of the palliative hospice platform; gentle, worn thin, and guarding his patients' final peace.
A revered silent hermit nearing death, celebrated for forty years of solitary contemplation.
Representative of families who lost loved ones in a wartime transport bombing; bitter, unyielding, and seeking long-delayed justice.
A quiet palliative habitat module anchored in the calm shadow of an outer moon.
A small, lead-shielded reliquary bay where the hermit's few worldly possessions are kept.

public_situation: Pilgrims gather at {role:quarantine_hospice_dock} to hold vigil for a celebrated ascetic hermit entering his final hours of silent contemplation.
private_truth: The dying hermit is a wartime demolition saboteur who blew up a passenger ferry forty years ago and hid in monastic vows to evade justice.

beats.public_change: Hospice attendants prepare the hermit's deathbed vigil as pilgrim ships dock at the perimeter.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to retrieve the hermit's sealed cedar personal trunk from the vault before the public vigil opens.
missions.private_fact: The chaplain heard the hermit's delirious confessions and fears the trunk holds incriminating documents rather than prayer beads.

beats.public_change: {role:survivor_advocate} docks an armed charter outside the hospice, presenting municipal warrants identifying the hermit as a mass murderer.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to scan the trunk's biometric seal and radio frequency log to confirm it holds the electronic trigger used in the ferry massacre.
missions.private_fact: Her family spent two generations bankrupting themselves to trace the saboteur's transponder across the sector.

beats.public_change: Pilgrims surround the hospice airlocks to block the advocate's party while the ascetic slips into cardiac arrest.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to move the confession trunk to a neutral station archive before rioting pilgrims and victims clash in the wards.
missions.private_fact: He knows publishing the truth will shatter the peace of hundreds of dying patients who drew strength from the hermit's example.

player_choice.prompt: Holding the undeniable proof that the dying saint was a fugitive mass murderer, the pilot must decide whether to deliver justice to the victims, preserve comfort for the dying, or bury the scandal quietly.

options.label: Give the confession trunk to the survivor advocate to grant the families closure
Help the chaplain seal the records so the dying pilgrims keep their peaceful faith
Sell the wartime confession to an independent historical bureau for a quiet payout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the confession trunk to the survivor advocate.
resolutions.summary: {role:survivor_advocate} proves the hermit's guilt before his death. The cult dissolves in shock, giving sixty grieving families long-sought closure.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered proof that an orbital saint was the fugitive saboteur behind a wartime ferry bombing.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps the chaplain seal the records away forever.
resolutions.summary: {role:hospice_chaplain} buries the trunk in space. The ascetic dies exalted, leaving terminal patients at peace while {role:survivor_advocate} leaves empty-handed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a hospice chaplain bury the private papers of a revered holy hermit.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the confession to an independent historical bureau.
resolutions.summary: Historical registries publish the confession posthumously. The hospice endures years of litigation, while {role:hospice_chaplain} resigns in disgrace.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold the deathbed confession of a fugitive bomber who hid forty years in a hospice.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the contract or never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: Survivor charters force the airlocks. Protesters clash with hospice security as the ascetic dies unconfessed, shuttering {role:quarantine_hospice_dock} indefinitely.

loose_threads.detail: The hermit's personal trunk has an arming frequency label scratched in military stencil that matches no known naval corps.
An offshore relief fund has transferred monthly survivor stipends to the hermit's hospice account since the armistice.

radio_hooks: Pilgrims hold candlelit orbital vigil outside hospice platform as beloved hermit weakens.
Survivor coalitions petition magistrate to unseal wartime refugee transport casualties.
Station public health board urges restraint outside quarantine hospice wards.

voice_direction.hospice_chaplain: Hushed, weary, and speaks with measured pauses. Never raises his voice, even when speaking of unspeakable atrocities.
voice_direction.survivor_advocate: Trembling with controlled rage, precise and legalistic. Emphasizes dates, casualty figures, and bureaucratic delay.

title: The Factor's Eviction Escrow
logline: An impartial residential escrow administrator attempts to mediate an eviction dispute, discovering that the landlord manufactured tenant defaults to lease the habitat block as mercenary shock troop barracks.

roles.description: An impartial residential escrow administrator; meticulous, formal, and strictly committed to contractual procedure.
Owner of the habitat's pressurized dorm pods; calculating, aggressive, and secretly contracting with private mercenary syndicates.
An outspoken hydroponics worker leading two hundred resident families defending their homes.
The station leasing registry where residential tenancy bonds are held.
A crowded residential tier housing miner and laborer families.

public_situation: Private bailiffs surround {role:pod_habitation_block} after the landlord files sudden default writs, while families barricade the pressurized corridor airlocks.
private_truth: The landlord manufactured the default claim to clear the block before the arrival of off-system mercenary shock troops who leased the pods as private barracks.

beats.public_change: Eviction enforcers post physical repossession notices across {role:pod_habitation_block} as airlock seals are disabled.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to purchase municipal court bond tokens to certify the tenants' escrow deposit before the magistrate closes filings.
missions.private_fact: The factor has all the tenants' rent held in escrow and cannot understand why the landlord is rushing eviction without mediation.

beats.public_change: Tenants reinforce airlock bulkheads with industrial jacks as {role:tenant_spokeswoman} calls for an immediate dockside strike.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to scan the leasing bureau's communication logs to verify why the landlord rejected their certified rent payments.
missions.private_fact: She intercepted docking manifests showing troop transport shuttles scheduled to arrive at the station within twenty-four hours.

beats.public_change: Armed security details move cutting rigs to the habitation hatches as the mercenary transport enters final docking approach.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to rush an emergency court injunction to the barricaded airlock to pause the eviction before gunfire starts.
missions.private_fact: He realizes that if the mercenary contract is executed, the entire residential ring will become an occupied military garrison.

player_choice.prompt: Holding proof of the landlord's secret mercenary lease and the factor's emergency injunction, the pilot must decide whether to stop the eviction, broker a relocation buyout, or sell out to the landlord.

options.label: Deliver the injunction to the station magistrate to halt the eviction and expose the illegal barracks
Deliver a negotiated relocation settlement so tenants receive moving funds before the troops land
Sell the leaked troop contracts back to the landlord to expedite immediate clearance

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the injunction to the magistrate.
resolutions.summary: The magistrate cancels the eviction and fines {role:syndicate_landlord} for illegal military staging. Families keep their homes in {role:pod_habitation_block}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a predatory landlord attempting to evict two hundred families to house mercenary shock troops.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the relocation settlement.
resolutions.summary: Families accept a relocation settlement, moving to outer freight pods. {role:syndicate_landlord} converts the blocks into barracks without bloodshed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot brokered an evacuation settlement between miner families and a station landlord before mercenaries landed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the leaked records to the landlord.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_landlord} uses private enforcers to breach the pods. Families are displaced into unheated berths while mercenaries occupy the sector.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot assisted a corrupt landlord in clearing civilian apartments for corporate shock troops.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the courier mission.
resolutions.summary: Mercenary vanguard units breach the habitat hatches with breaching charges. Civilian residents flee into cargo bays while {role:housing_factor} shuts his office.

loose_threads.detail: The station docking registry lists an anonymous corporate deposit reserving thirty heavy shuttle berths on commercial credit.
The landlord's cargo bay holds palletized high-capacity industrial oxygen filters stamped with private security seals.

radio_hooks: Standoff escalates at pod habitation ring as tenant barricades resist eviction bailiffs.
Station tenancy board reminds residents that lease terms are strictly enforced.
Docking authority alerts commercial berths to incoming private transport convoys.

voice_direction.housing_factor: Punctilious, dry, and recites municipal code with reflexive nervousness. Struggles to maintain administrative dignity when threatened.
voice_direction.syndicate_landlord: Brusque, impatient, and treats tenants as delinquent equipment. Cuts off questions with sharp commercial ultimatums.
voice_direction.tenant_spokeswoman: Hoarse, resolute, and speaks with fierce communal protectiveness. Directly challenges legal evasions.
